html:
An eruption of Pico do Fogo, the active volcano that forms Fogo island in Cape Verde, which began on 23 November 2014 and lasted until February 2015.

Lava flowed across Cha das Caldeiras, the crater plain where about a thousand people grew grapes and coffee, and destroyed the villages of Portela and Bangaeira, the park centre and the road. Nobody died, as people were evacuated. Earlier eruptions had come in 1951 and 1995, and the island's history of drought and eruption fed emigration to the United States. Many villagers went back to rebuild on the lava. See also Cape Verde and volcanoes.
sum: An eruption of Pico do Fogo, the active volcano that forms Fogo island in Cape Verde, which began on 23 November 2014 and lasted until February 2015.
